yatra.price: ₹5,49,000 per person (including international flights) + 5% GST + 2% TCS (TCS refunded/credited through your income-tax return)

days.title: Hyderabad & Bangalore → London Heathrow · Kamada Ekadasi
days.summary: Hyderabad group flies Emirates via Dubai (dep 04:40, arrive Heathrow 16:10); Bangalore group flies Etihad via Abu Dhabi (dep 10:00, arrive 18:45). Kamada Ekadasi: fruit meals on board. Welcome kirtan and dinner at the hotel.

rows.detail: HYDERABAD GROUP: report at RGIA departures (3 h before). Tour manager hands over tickets, insurance, kit (cap, bag, ID card, name badge). Group check-in on Emirates; bag drop. 25 kg check-in + 7 kg cabin. Today is Kamada Ekadasi: fruit meals (FPML) pre-ordered on both flights.

rows.where: Rajiv Gandhi International Airport (HYD) → Heathrow Terminal 3
rows.detail: HYDERABAD GROUP: Emirates EK 525 HYD 04:40 → Dubai 06:45 (T3); 4 h 40 m layover; EK 31 Dubai 11:25 → Heathrow T3 16:10. Ekadasi: fruit meals on board; carry dry fruits, nuts, makhana.

BANGALORE GROUP: report at Kempegowda T2 (3 h before). Group check-in on Etihad (first leg operated by Akasa Air); confirm bags are checked through to London. 30 kg check-in + 7 kg cabin. Ekadasi fruit meals pre-ordered.

rows.where: Kempegowda International Airport (BLR), T2 → Heathrow Terminal 4
rows.detail: BANGALORE GROUP: Etihad EY 1013 (Akasa Air) BLR T2 10:00 → Abu Dhabi 12:35; 1 h 35 m layover; EY 67 Abu Dhabi 14:10 → Heathrow T4 18:45.
HYDERABAD GROUP: UK Border (eVisa linked to passport), baggage claim, meet the tour manager at the T3 coach park. Headcount.
Coach run 1: Hyderabad group to the hotel. Welcome talk, group rules, WhatsApp group, SIM/eSIM help.
Hyderabad group check-in, rest.
Coach run 2 (empty) back to Heathrow T4 for the Bangalore group.
Hotel / Indian caterer – Ekadasi (grain-free) menu. Hyderabad group dinner. No grains, beans, onion or garlic: fruit, potato, sabudana, paneer, nuts, milk.
BANGALORE GROUP: UK Border, baggage claim, meet the coach at T4. Headcount.
Coach run 2: Bangalore group to the hotel.
Hotel / Indian caterer – Ekadasi (grain-free) menu. Bangalore group dinner.
Joint welcome kirtan and briefing. Tomorrow: break fast (Dvadasi parana) 05:59–10:40 at breakfast (08:00–09:00); coach 09:00. Sunset tonight about 20:05; jet lag: sleep by 22:30.

meals.Dinner: 19:30 · Hotel, Wembley area (TBC) · Hotel / Indian caterer – Ekadasi (grain-free) menu; 20:45 · Hotel, Wembley area (TBC) · Hotel / Indian caterer – Ekadasi (grain-free) menu

days.title: Akshaya Patra Watford · Bhaktivedanta Manor Sunday programme · Madame Tussauds · ISKCON Soho · Covent Garden
days.summary: Visit the Akshaya Patra kitchen in Watford, then Bhaktivedanta Manor for darshan of Sri Sri Radha-Gokulananda, the Sunday programme and feast prasadam. Afternoon at Madame Tussauds; evening arati at ISKCON Soho, where Srila Prabhupada installed Radha-Londonishvara in 1969; stroll through Covent Garden.
days.short: Akshaya Patra · Bhaktivedanta Manor · Madame Tussauds · ISKCON Soho

rows.detail: Japa (16 rounds at own pace), short kirtan and Bhagavatam reading in the hotel hall or lobby (before breakfast; optional).
Hotel – complimentary buffet (08:00–09:00) – Dvadasi break fast between 05:59 and 10:40 (London). Break the Ekadasi fast with grains at breakfast.

rows.where: Hotel, Wembley area (TBC) → Akshaya Patra UK central kitchen, Watford
rows.detail: Coach north-west via A406/A41 to Watford (Imperial Way). Today's route runs one way: Watford in the morning, then into central London, then back to Wembley — no back-tracking.

rows.where: Akshaya Patra UK central kitchen, Watford
rows.detail: Akshaya Patra UK central kitchen, Watford: opened in 2020, cooks up to 9,000 free school meals a day for UK schools; zero-carbon, zero-waste design. Akshaya Patra was founded in 2000 by the Hare Krishna Movement (ISKCON Bangalore), our own movement. Kitchen walk-through (hairnets given), short film, meet the team. Walking ~300 m, flat.
rows.note: By appointment only: akshayapatra.org.uk/contact, tel. 020 800 48743. The kitchen cooks on school days, so on a Sunday it is usually not cooking: ask for a walk-through and film. Coach parks inside the trading estate (confirm).

rows.where: Akshaya Patra UK central kitchen, Watford → Bhaktivedanta Manor, ISKCON (Watford)
rows.detail: Short coach hop (7 km) to Bhaktivedanta Manor; Hilfield Lane entrance, coach park on site.

Bhaktivedanta Manor: darshan of Sri Sri Radha-Gokulananda and Sita-Rama-Lakshmana-Hanuman, Srila Prabhupada's rooms, gardens, lake and goshala. Story of George Harrison's gift of the Manor. Walking ~1 km on paths and lawns.
Sunday programme: kirtan and Bhagavad-gita class with the London devotees.
rows.note: Morning Sunday programme 11:30–13:00 (last entry 11:45). Free; tel. 01923 851000. Inform the Manor of a 40-person group.

rows.detail: Bhaktivedanta Manor – Sunday feast prasadam (donation).

rows.where: Bhaktivedanta Manor, ISKCON (Watford) → Madame Tussauds London
rows.detail: Coach via A41/A5 (Edgware Road) into Marylebone. Set-down on Marylebone Road at the attraction; the coach then parks in a booked coach bay (no waiting outside Tussauds).

Madame Tussauds: Bollywood stars, the royal family, world leaders (Gandhi, Modi), sports and Marvel; 'Spirit of London' taxi ride. Timed group entry 15:00. Walking ~1 km indoors; stairs with lifts available.
rows.note: Book the 15:00 group slot. Check the 2027 Sunday closing time (last entry is usually 1–2 h before closing).

rows.where: Madame Tussauds London → Coach set-down, Soho Square / Charing Cross Road
rows.detail: Coach to the Soho Square / Charing Cross Road set-down. Coaches cannot enter Soho's narrow streets: set down and pick up only.

rows.where: Coach set-down, Soho Square / Charing Cross Road → Radha-Krishna Temple, ISKCON Soho (10 Soho Street)
rows.detail: Walk 200 m along Soho Street to the temple.

rows.where: Radha-Krishna Temple, ISKCON Soho (10 Soho Street)
rows.detail: ISKCON Soho – Sri Sri Radha-Londonishvara, the first ISKCON deities in the UK, installed by Srila Prabhupada in 1969 (the year of the Beatles-produced 'Hare Krishna Mantra' single). Sunday evening arati and kirtan, history talk, Govinda's shop for snacks and books.

rows.where: Radha-Krishna Temple, ISKCON Soho (10 Soho Street) → Covent Garden Piazza & Royal Opera House
rows.detail: Walk 1 km through Soho and Seven Dials to Covent Garden (flat pavements, busy crossings: walk in a line behind the flag).

rows.where: Covent Garden Piazza & Royal Opera House
rows.detail: Covent Garden Piazza and street performers; Royal Opera House (exterior; the April 2027 opera is Tosca, but there is no performance on 18 or 19 April); Lyceum Theatre on Wellington Street, home of The Lion King (exterior).
rows.note: The Lion King has no show on Monday and only a 14:30 matinee on Sunday, so it does not fit this day without dropping the Manor programme (see Plan B in the doc).

rows.where: Covent Garden Piazza & Royal Opera House → Coach pick-up, Aldwych / Strand
rows.detail: Walk down Wellington Street to the coach pick-up on Aldwych / Strand (pick-up only, coach cannot wait).

rows.where: Coach pick-up, Aldwych / Strand → Hotel, Wembley area (TBC)
rows.detail: Coach back to Wembley (light Sunday-evening traffic).
Hotel – Satvik menu pre-agreed (or Indian caterer delivering to the hotel).
Tomorrow: coach 09:00 sharp. The Changing of the Guard is at 11:00 and we must be in position by 10:15. About 6–7 km of walking and ~1.5 h of standing tomorrow: comfortable shoes, umbrella, water.

meals.Lunch: 13:00 · Bhaktivedanta Manor, ISKCON (Watford) · Bhaktivedanta Manor – Sunday feast prasadam (donation)

days.title: Royal London: Changing of the Guard · King's Gallery · Tower of London (Koh-i-Noor) · Tower Bridge · Thames boat · London Eye · Westminster
days.summary: Changing of the Guard at Buckingham Palace and The King's Gallery; the Tower of London with the Crown Jewels and the Koh-i-Noor; a walk on Tower Bridge; a Thames boat ride; the London Eye at sunset; Big Ben and the Houses of Parliament.
days.short: Royal London: Guard · Tower & Koh-i-Noor · Thames · London Eye

rows.detail: Japa (16 rounds at own pace), short kirtan and Bhagavatam reading in the hotel hall or lobby (before breakfast; optional).
Hotel – complimentary buffet (08:00–09:00).

rows.where: Hotel, Wembley area (TBC) → Coach set-down, Buckingham Palace Road (Royal Mews)
rows.detail: Coach via A40/Park Lane to the set-down on Buckingham Palace Road (by the Royal Mews). Today's route is one loop: west (palace) → east (Tower) by coach, back west (Westminster) by boat, then home. Coaches may not park or wait on Buckingham Gate or The Mall: the coach parks in a booked bay and returns at 12:45.
rows.note: Monday rush hour: leave on time. Coach must be ULEZ-compliant (Euro VI); the Congestion Charge applies 07:00–18:00.

rows.where: Coach set-down, Buckingham Palace Road (Royal Mews) → Buckingham Palace – Changing of the Guard
rows.detail: Walk 500 m to the Victoria Memorial in front of Buckingham Palace.

rows.where: Buckingham Palace – Changing of the Guard
rows.detail: Buckingham Palace – Changing of the Guard (King's Guard), 11:00–11:45: the Foot Guards in red tunics and bearskins, the military band, the handover of the palace keys. Best spots: Victoria Memorial steps or the palace railings. Standing ~1.5 h.
rows.note: King's Guard changes Mon/Wed/Fri at 11:00 (Household Division calendar). Free. Cancelled in very wet weather or for state events: check householddivision.org.uk the evening before. Pickpockets work this crowd.

rows.detail: The King's Gallery (formerly the Queen's Gallery), Buckingham Palace: Royal Collection exhibition of paintings and treasures. This is the royal museum open in April; the Palace State Rooms open only in summer (July–September). Timed group entry 11:45. Walking ~500 m indoors.
rows.note: Group rate £19.80 (2026). Check the 2027 exhibition and opening dates on rct.uk. Alternative if closed: the Royal Mews (royal carriages), next door.

rows.where: The King's Gallery, Buckingham Palace → Coach set-down, Buckingham Palace Road (Royal Mews)
rows.detail: Walk 400 m back to the coach on Buckingham Palace Road.

rows.where: Coach set-down, Buckingham Palace Road (Royal Mews) → Tower Hill coach park (Lower Thames Street)
rows.detail: Coach along the Embankment past Westminster and St Paul's to Tower Hill coach park (Lower Thames Street; free drop-off under 15 min, then the coach parks there).

rows.where: Indian vegetarian restaurant near Tower Hill (TBC)
rows.detail: Indian vegetarian restaurant near Tower Hill (to be booked). Backup: packed Satvik lunch from the London caterer, eaten before entering the Tower.

rows.where: Indian vegetarian restaurant near Tower Hill (TBC) → Tower of London – Crown Jewels (Kohinoor)
rows.detail: Walk 300 m to the Tower's group entrance.

Tower of London: go first to the Jewel House to see the Crown Jewels, including the Koh-i-Noor diamond in the Queen Mother's crown (narrate its journey from Golconda/Kollur near Hyderabad to London); then a Yeoman Warder (Beefeater) tour, the White Tower, the ravens and the walls. Walking ~1.5 km on cobbles; steep spiral stairs in the White Tower.
rows.note: Summer hours Mon 10:00–17:30. Book a timed group entry (14:15) with the Historic Royal Palaces groups desk (15+ rate).

rows.where: Tower of London – Crown Jewels (Kohinoor) → Tower Bridge
rows.detail: Walk onto Tower Bridge and back (1.2 km): photos, HMS Belfast, the Shard, and the real London Bridge upstream. Optional: Tower Bridge glass walkway (extra ticket).
Walk down to Tower Millennium Pier.

rows.where: Tower Millennium Pier → London Eye Pier (Thames cruise)
rows.detail: Thames boat upstream (Uber Boat RB1, or City Cruises with live commentary): under London Bridge, past Shakespeare's Globe, St Paul's and Somerset House to the London Eye. The coach drives empty to Westminster meanwhile.
London Eye – 30-minute rotation in evening light (timed group slot 18:15): Parliament, Buckingham Palace, St Paul's, the Shard. Step-free.
rows.note: Check the 2027 April closing time before fixing the slot; group rate 10+.

rows.where: London Eye → Westminster – Big Ben & Houses of Parliament
rows.detail: Walk over Westminster Bridge (600 m).

rows.where: Westminster – Big Ben & Houses of Parliament
rows.detail: Big Ben (Elizabeth Tower) and the Palace of Westminster — the Houses of Parliament: the House of Commons and the House of Lords (the Lords end is the Victoria Tower, by the Victoria Tower Gardens); Westminster Abbey; Parliament Square statues including Mahatma Gandhi. Sunset about 20:07.
rows.note: Outside only: Parliament usually sits on Mondays and its guided tours run on Saturdays and recess weekdays. Check parliament.uk once the 2027 recess dates are out.

rows.where: Westminster – Big Ben & Houses of Parliament → Coach pick-up, Victoria Embankment (Westminster Pier)
rows.detail: Walk 300 m to the coach pick-up on Victoria Embankment by Westminster Pier.

rows.where: Coach pick-up, Victoria Embankment (Westminster Pier) → Hotel, Wembley area (TBC)
rows.detail: Coach back to Wembley.
Hotel – Satvik menu pre-agreed (or Indian caterer delivering to the hotel).
Pack tonight; luggage in the lobby at 08:45. Passports in hand luggage for the EU border check at Dover.

inclusions: All airfare (ex-Hyderabad / Chennai / Bangalore or any South Indian city)
All sightseeing as in the itinerary
exclusions: Driver tips at EUR 3 per person per day
Optional extras not in the itinerary: Lion King show, Leaning Tower climb, Doge's Palace, other optional entries
visa: UK visa: apply from about 17 Jan 2027 (max 3 months before); decision usually 3 weeks after biometrics. Schengen: apply to Italy (longest stay) between Jan and early Mar 2027 (max 6 months, min 15 days before); normally 15 days, up to 45. Do UK first, then Schengen.
Current passport + previous passports if any. Print the first and last pages, plus pages with travel history (black & white is fine). Valid 3+ months beyond 3 May 2027 and 2 blank pages.
Schengen visa photos, 35 mm × 45 mm, white background, matte or glossy, no spectacles, 2 copies. Do not bring ordinary passport-size photos.
Personal or company ITR-V acknowledgement for the last 3 financial years (FY 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26). Balance sheet not needed.
Personal or company account, last 3 months, sealed and signed by the bank. Minimum balance about ₹3 lakh per person.
On company letterhead, or plain paper if there is none, signed by the sponsor (self, spouse or company). Add an explanation letter with proof for any sudden large deposit.
If travelling on company funds or showing company ITR-V and bank statements: company registration or GST registration certificate.
Provided by organisers at the biometric office

Covering letter from Goldenavatar Ventures Pvt Ltd for the group, its ITR-V (3 years), 3-month sealed bank statement and incorporation letter, travel insurance (must cover the UK too), hotel confirmations, flight tickets, the filled visa application form.
£135 Standard Visitor visa, issued as an eVisa linked to the passport (each yatri creates a UKVI account). No UK ETA needed with a visa. Keep a scan of every Schengen document; most are reused.
dos: Carry your passport, visa and insurance card on travel days; keep a photocopy separately.
Be at the coach 5 minutes before the departure time announced.
Wear comfortable walking shoes already broken in; 10,000–15,000 steps on city days.
Dress modestly for churches and the Vatican: shoulders and knees covered, no caps inside.
Keep a small day-bag: water, cap, sunscreen, umbrella, light jacket, medicines, chargers.
Pre-inform the tour manager of medical conditions and dietary needs.
Use the buddy system; keep your phone on and charged (power bank).
Respect temple etiquette abroad: shoes off, no photos of deities where asked, offer a donation if you wish.
Keep coins of EUR and CHF for toilets (often €0.50–€1).
Ask for VAT refund forms on purchases over the minimum (varies by country).
Drink plenty of water, especially in Italy.
Keep the coach clean; take your waste with you.
donts: Don't carry valuables or large amounts of cash in back pockets or open bags.
Don't sign petitions or accept 'free' bracelets or roses from strangers (common scams).
Don't wander off alone; never leave the group without telling the tour manager.
Don't bring banned food items from India (meat, dairy, fresh fruit and vegetables into the UK/EU). Packaged food is mostly fine; declare it if in doubt.
Don't climb the Leaning Tower or do the Titlis Cliff Walk if you have heart, BP or knee problems.
Don't take photos in the Sistine Chapel or where signs prohibit it.
Don't eat in the coach unless permitted by the driver; no hot food.
Don't block the bus aisle or leave bags in the stairwell.
Don't buy from street sellers near monuments (counterfeit goods; fines in Italy and France for buyers).
Don't overstay your visa or lose your stamps; keep boarding passes until home.
practical: Weather in late April
15–21 °C by day, 6–11 °C at night, rain on 3–5 days in 11. Titisee mornings near freezing. Titlis summit −2 to −7 °C with snow. Sunset 20:00–21:00.
Currency
UK: GBP (£). France, Belgium, Netherlands, Germany, Italy, Vatican: EUR (€). Switzerland: CHF (EUR widely accepted at a poor rate). A multi-currency forex card plus a little cash in each.
Power plugs
UK: Type G (3-pin). Europe: Type C/F (2 round pins). Switzerland: Type J (Type C fits). Carry a universal adapter and a power bank.
Mobile & data
An international roaming pack or a Europe + UK eSIM. Switzerland is often excluded from EU packs, so check. Make WhatsApp the group channel.
Time zones
UK = IST − 4 h 30 m (BST). France to Italy = IST − 3 h 30 m (CEST). Abu Dhabi = IST − 1 h 30 m.
Tipping
Driver EUR 3 per person per day (collected by the tour manager). Local guides 2–5 EUR per person per tour (optional). Restaurants: service usually included.
Emergency numbers

UK 999 / 112; EU and Switzerland 112. Indian High Commission London +44 20 7836 8484 (verify); Indian embassies in Paris, Brussels, The Hague, Berlin, Bern and Rome (save their numbers before departure).
Senior-citizen care
Seats near the front, wheelchair booking at the Louvre, Vatican and airports, extra rest stops, a medicine pouch with prescriptions, an attendant ratio of 1:10, lifts used wherever available.
Packing

Cold and wet spring weather
London 7–15 °C with showers; Black Forest near 0 °C at night; Titlis summit about −5 °C in snow; Italy 10–21 °C.
Warm jacket, thermal layer, gloves and cap for Titlis; umbrellas; non-slip shoes.
Holidays and events
1 May Labour Day in Italy (Florence/Pisa crowds); French presidential election 18 Apr and 2 May; Keukenhof and Zaanse Schans busy on Saturday.
Pre-book all timed entries; go early; avoid political rallies in Paris.
Central London coach rules
Coaches cannot enter Soho or Covent Garden, cannot wait at Buckingham Gate, The Mall or outside attractions; ULEZ (Euro VI coach) and the Congestion Charge apply.
Coach operator to pre-book coach bays (TfL coach parking map), use set-down/pick-up points in the timetable, and keep the group to time at every pick-up (the coach cannot wait).
Pickpockets
London (Changing of the Guard crowd, Covent Garden), Paris (Eiffel, Louvre, Métro), Rome (Trevi, Colosseum, Termini station), Venice crowds.
Neck pouches, zipped bags worn in front, passports in the hotel safe except on ticket days, buddy system.
Satvik food availability
Most restaurants use onion and garlic; few Indian restaurants in small towns.
Written no-onion/no-garlic menus; temple prasadam on 5 meals; packed lunches on 2 days; carry ready meals and dry snacks.
Senior citizens' stamina
Long walks (Louvre, Vatican, Venice), steps (Pisa, Venice bridges), altitude (Titlis), the 05:00–22:30 Rome day.
Wheelchairs at museums, a rest option in Florence on Day 14, slow group with an assistant, pre-departure medical check.
Visas and biometrics
UK visa can be applied for only 3 months before travel; Schengen up to 6 months before. Passports are held during processing.
UK first (mid-to-late Jan 2027), then Schengen via Italy (by late Feb / early Mar 2027).
Lost passport or luggage
12 hotels in 15 nights.
Group luggage tags, a daily luggage count, scans of passports and visas, Indian embassy contacts.
